hero.subtitle: Private transport and flight | Approximately 40 minutes | Air-and-land tour

description.title: Your Sky, Your Rules
description.paragraph: The catalogue's most complete private experience: exclusive transport, a flight just for your group, French champagne with waiter service, ceremonial caves, brunch, and an archaeological-zone tour with a historian. Flight photos and video are already included.

steps.title: 5:00 AM - Arrive & Check-in
steps.description: You’ll arrive at Flying Pictures Reception, where our team will welcome you and help you complete check-in.

steps.title: Welcome & Coffee Break
steps.description: After you complete your check-in we will welcome you with our coffee station with hot beverages and traditional cookies.

steps.title: The Inflation Spectacle
steps.description: Walk to the launch field to watch the "Giants" come to life. Seeing the massive balloons rise with the roar of the burners is the first act of the show.

steps.title: The Ascent
steps.description: Lift off gently into the dawn. For approx. 45-60 minutes, float silently over the Valley of Teotihuacán, watching the sun reveal the pyramids from above.

steps.title: The 1783 Toast
steps.description: Upon landing, we celebrate with a traditional sparkling wine toast. A ritual dating back to the first aviators to thank the wind gods for a safe return.

included: Private round-trip transport between Mexico City and Teotihuacán with coordinated pickup
Coffee break with cookies and traditional Mexican drinks
Waiter service with canapés, guacamole, coffee, bread, and local fruit
Private guided ceremonial-cave tour of approximately 30 minutes
Traditional brunch at a local restaurant
Private archaeological-zone tour of approximately two and a half hours with a historian
notIncluded: $110 MXN per-person fee for non-resident foreign visitors
notes: A minimum booking of four people is required.
An additional adult costs $3,999 MXN and the child price is $3,499 MXN.
Non-resident foreign visitors pay an additional $110 MXN per person upon arrival.

steps.title: Travel in private transport
steps.description: An exclusive vehicle takes your group from Mexico City to Teotihuacán.

steps.title: Enjoy the coffee break
steps.description: We welcome you with coffee, cookies, and traditional Mexican drinks.

steps.title: Board your private balloon
steps.description: Only your group shares the basket during the flight.

steps.title: Fly for approximately 40 minutes
steps.description: The team captures photos and video while you enjoy views of the valley.

steps.title: Enjoy champagne and canapés
steps.description: A waiter serves the toast, guacamole, coffee, bread, and local fruit.

steps.title: Explore ceremonial caves
steps.description: Take a private guided tour lasting approximately 30 minutes.

steps.title: Try a traditional brunch
steps.description: Enjoy local dishes at a nearby restaurant.

steps.title: Tour the pyramids with a historian
steps.description: A specialist accompanies your group for approximately two and a half hours.

steps.title: Receive your certificate, photos, and video
steps.description: Finish with your personalised certificate and the media from your experience.
